legal.title: Privacy and Data Protection Policy
legal.subtitle: Compliance with the General Data Protection Law (Law No. 13,709/2018)
legal.s1b: We collect only the data strictly necessary for the system to work, including: name, corporate e-mail, CPF, date of birth, phone, legal guardian data, enrollment information and health data (physical assessments and BMI) for educational purposes.
legal.s2b: Data is used exclusively for: educational and academic performance monitoring, attendance control, physical and vocational assessments, administrative management, and compliance with legal and regulatory obligations.
legal.s3b1: Consent (Art. 7, I) — for general personal data
legal.s3b2: Specific consent for health data (Art. 11) — physical assessments
legal.s3b4: Legal obligation (Art. 7, II) — when required by law
legal.s4b: Data is not shared with third parties without express consent, except when required by law or court order. We only use the hosting service (Supabase), which follows international security standards.
legal.s5b: We adopt technical and organizational measures to protect data, including: transmission encryption (SSL/TLS), encryption of sensitive data at rest, password hashing with bcrypt, role-based access control (RBAC), and access logs (audit logs).
legal.s6b: Data is kept while the school/contractual relationship lasts. After that, data is deleted or anonymized, unless retention is required to comply with a legal obligation.
legal.s7b1: Confirm that your data is being processed
legal.s7b3: Correct incomplete, inaccurate or outdated data
legal.s7b4: Anonymize, block or delete unnecessary data
legal.s7b6: Deletion of data processed with consent

desempenho.textoM7BiologicasCriativasBasicData:
Basic Data: A profile driven by creativity. Shows a strong desire to invent, innovate or has a deep interest in the study of life, well-being and health.

Related Careers: Medicine, Biology, Design, Advertising, Visual Arts, Physical Education and Veterinary Medicine.
desempenho.textoM7BiologicasCriativasReflection: I observe in the student a unique combination of inventive sensitivity and organic empathy. This profile moves away from strict, traditional scientism; instead, it finds motivation in applying creative solutions to challenges involving living beings and human expression. Their mind is guided by the need to discover new alternatives, to heal, to design or to transform the environment. The strong presence of creativity in this macro-area indicates that the young person finds it easy to think "outside the box" when facing complex health or visual communication problems, making them ideal for careers that demand innovation in caring for life or developing new aesthetic concepts.
desempenho.textoM7ExatasTecnologicasBasicData:
Basic Data: A profile stimulated by solving logical problems, ease in handling numerical data and a deep interest in deciphering how new technologies work.

Related Careers: Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, Architecture and Information Technology.
desempenho.textoM7ExatasTecnologicasReflection: We diagnose in the student a predominantly abstract, analytical and deductive cognitive structure. Their mind operates systematically and finds motivation in discovering patterns, equations and data architecture. The young person is not content to be merely a passive user of digital tools and modern world constructions; there is an intrinsic intellectual curiosity to understand the "how" and the "why" behind technological and structural gears. This inclination toward methodological precision provides a solid foundation for careers in software development or engineering, environments where logical rigor serves as the raw material for designing and building tomorrow’s solutions.
desempenho.textoM7HumanasSociaisBasicData:
Basic Data: A profile grounded in the ability to communicate clearly, strong empathy for welcoming and helping others, plus a critical interest in understanding the structures of society.

Related Careers: Law, Literature, Pedagogy, Psychology, History, Journalism and International Relations.
